label: Multi-server Hosting Pro
summary: Advanced hosting orchestration across admitted servers: enrollment workflows, trust review, tenant/resource placement, scoped node routing, capacity groups, maintenance/drain waves and fleet care. It coordinates existing per-resource operations and observed outcomes rather than introducing a second authoritative node or customer registry.
core_boundary: Single-node hosting, identity/tenant boundaries, service control, local recovery and any future admitted node/provider/transport foundations remain open-source Core responsibilities. This premium module adds multi-server workflow intent and coordination only; it has no raw shell, privileged socket, direct Core database access or implicit authority over remote servers.
acceptance: Admit nodes through reviewed enrollment, peer identity, trust roots, key rotation/revocation and version/capability evidence; reject unknown, replaced or replayed identities.
Resolve each tenant/resource to authoritative node placement and current route/revision before dispatch; never select a destination solely from a client-supplied node ID.
Qualify scheduling and capacity policy against effective CPU/RAM/storage/network limits, locality and isolation; distinguish recommendations from reserved or enforced resources.
Exercise leases/fencing, stale workers, concurrent placement, partitions, delayed acknowledgements and unavailable control paths without cross-tenant effects or competing active owners.
Track drain, maintenance, certificate/runtime upgrades and fleet-care waves with bounded batches, per-node results and service-specific recovery.
Document which existing workloads continue during controller/provider outage; keep uncertain operations reconcilable instead of blindly replaying them on another node.
Qualify resource migration and return-to-service checks with the owning Hosting/Data/Mail/Files/Transfers/BackupRestore contracts, retained recovery points and explicit cutover authority.
Disable the premium coordinator without interrupting established node workloads or independent Core control, ownership inventory and recovery on each admitted server.
